name: IYPS
tagline: Check how strong your passwords really are
description:
IYPS, short for "Is Your Password Safe", tests how strong your passwords actually are. It estimates how long it would take someone to crack a password and gives clear, practical suggestions for making it stronger.

Everything is calculated right on your device, so you can check your passwords without ever sending them anywhere. It's a quick, honest reality check for anyone who wants better password habits.
